subject: Request: subprocessor inventory + SIG/CAIQ evidence for procurement review
messages:
From: Alexis Turner <procurement@medisure.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Subprocessor list + SIG/CAIQ evidence for procurement review

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking this on. MediSure's procurement team is working through our vendor security assessment and we need a few items to complete our review: 1) the current subprocessor roster (names, service provided, region of data residency), 2) SOC 2 report or summary attestation, and 3) either a completed CAIQ or SIG-lite that covers data handling, encryption, and key management.

If you can provide a redacted roster and a roadmap for full evidence delivery that would be helpful. We have a deadline for committee review on Dec 20 — can you confirm whether you can deliver by then and what the handoff mechanism will be (secure upload, SFTP, or shareable Drive link)?

For context I've attached our standard procurement request template.

Thanks,
Alexis Turner
Procurement Manager, MediSure Health
procurement@medisure.com
Attachment: procurement_request.pdf
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alexis Turner <procurement@medisure.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Subprocessor list + SIG/CAIQ evidence for procurement review

Hi Alexis —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can support this request. Preliminary answers and proposed plan below: 

- Redacted subprocessor roster: attached as CSV (service + region; no contacts). We will mark hosted infrastructure, KMS, telemetry, and analytics providers as separate categories.
- SOC 2: we can provide our SOC 2 Type II summary and a statement of scope (see attached). Full report available under an NDA if required.
- CAIQ vs SIG: we maintain a full SIG compiled for enterprise customers; for procurement teams we can deliver either a completed CAIQ or a SIG-lite mapping. Please confirm which artifact you prefer.

Proposed delivery timeline:
- Today (Dec 9): redacted roster + SOC 2 summary delivered (attached).
- By Dec 15: CAIQ export or SIG-lite + KMS residency notes + redacted evidence bundle (SAML configs, encryption-at-rest docs).
- If you require the full SOC 2 report or scoped evidence, we will need an NDA and a secure transfer window (SFTP or signed Drive link) — estimate +48 hours after NDA.

We can upload the Dec 15 bundle to a secure Google Drive folder and provide time-limited access, or use your SFTP if you prefer. Which do you prefer?

I'll loop Marissa for CAIQ compilation and Jordan for KMS/residency notes.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redacted_subprocessor_roster_20261209.csv; SOC2-summary-2026.pdf
From: Alexis Turner <procurement@medisure.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 9 Dec 2026 11:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Subprocessor list + SIG/CAIQ evidence for procurement review

Hi Kimberly —

This is great, thanks. A couple clarifications: 

- For our review the SIG-lite mapping is sufficient (we only score a subset of modules), but we do need explicit KMS residency (which regions hold keys and where KMS administrative access originates).
- Please include attestation language around export controls / cross-border transfers for EU-origin data.
- Drive upload is fine; we require time-limited links and an access log. SFTP is optional.

If you can get the roster and SOC2 now and the SIG-lite + KMS notes by Dec 15, procurement can run the committee on Dec 20. We may reach out with a short follow-up list after we review the SIG-lite.

Thanks,
Alexis

Quick internal next steps for the Dec 15 delivery: 

- Marissa: owner for SIG-lite mapping and evidence bundle. Compile answers for these modules: DTA, Encryption, Identity & Access, and Third-Party Management. Export CAIQ fields where useful but SIG-lite is primary. Target: draft by EOD Dec 13.
- Jordan: owner for KMS residency and export-control language. Provide a short attestation with residency table (service, key region, admin access IP ranges) + redacted logs/outputs if needed. Target: Dec 14.
- Kim (me): review, redact where necessary (PII removed), and coordinate Drive access & audit log settings. I will prepare the NDA template in case they request the full SOC 2 report.

Please keep items as redacted artifacts (no internal engineer emails or on-call phone numbers). Use shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-example-upload (request access if you don't have it).

We will confirm final upload window on Dec 15 and send Alexis time-limited links with an access audit.

Thanks — Kim
